comment: The apply_note_change argument object every client sends: the 15-argument overload, whose p_attachment_ids names exactly the uploaded (r2:) attachments the version references (none here; pending: images have no server row yet). restore_note takes the other 14 only. Key names and value types are the contract; p_base_revision is null on a note the server has never seen. Whether each client's argument set matches a deployed signature is checked against supabase/migrations by RpcSignatureContractTest (Kotlin) and rpcSignatureContract.test.ts (web).
